'''Looti Vario'''<ref name="Trailer sw.com">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-maul-shadow-lord-trailer|text=Watch the Official Trailer for ''Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord''}}</ref> was an [[Aleena]] [[crime lord]]<ref name="Solicit" /> who was active on the [[Mid Rim Territories]] [[planet|world]] of [[Janix]] during the early [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="SOM1" /> A scheming scoundrel,<ref name="Trailer sw.com" /> Vario made use of a mechanical suit of armor to bolster his otherwise diminutive height.<ref name="Teaser">{{SWYouTube|oonACDq89BY|Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord | Official Teaser Trailer | Streaming April 6 on Disney+}}</ref> After [[Captain]] [[Brander Lawson]] of Janix's [[Tactical Defense Force]] botched a smuggling bust, the [[Law enforcement agency|police force's]] [[Chief]] [[Klyce]] assigned him a [[Brander Lawson's squad|team]], to whom he showed [[hologram|wanted posters]] of Janix's foremost [[crime lord]]s, being a [[Pau'an]], a [[Gran]], and Vario himself.<ref name="SOM1">[[Shadow of Maul 1|''Shadow of Maul'' 1]]</ref> Sometime later, when Lawson was hunted by an [[assassin]] and officer from his own department, Vario became an unlikely ally, though the Aleena had his own hidden agenda.<ref name="Solicit" /> At one point, Vario, flanked by two [[droid]] guards, ate a [[Foodstuff|meal]] with the Gran crime lord, who was likewise protected by two [[Trandoshan]]s. However, the latter party ended up firing upon the former, causing the Aleena to duck behind his protectors.<ref name="Teaser" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Looti Vario is set to appear in the [[Disney+]] television show ''[[Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord]]''. The character will be voiced by [[Chris Diamantopoulos]].<ref name="teaser sw.com" /> Vario was first pictured in the show's teaser trailer, which released on [[January 22]], [[2026]], with the Aleena's name and voice actor being announced in the [[StarWars.com]] article that accompanied its release.<ref name="teaser sw.com">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-maul-shadow-lord-first-trailer-poster-art|text=Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord Teaser Trailer and First Poster Arrive}}</ref>
